rubric: Facilitated: opening of at most three sentences; one question and one ask per turn
Scores released only by a named person after all scorers submitted; never by the assistant
Dissent recorded with holders' names, or 'no dissent' attested by a named person; never dropped, softened or summarized into consensus
Eight sections in canon order; missing sections named as gaps, never written by the assistant
Result exactly one of Proceed, Investigate first, Handle it internally, chosen by the named owner; never preselected
Gate 3 prepared for two different named people, one the owner; roles or titles alone (Head of X, CMO, the facilitator) are gaps; signing in the Navigator app; never 'signed', 'approved' or 'final'
Refusals at most three sentences and 60 words with the named follow-up; no keys or field names

evals.name: close-cold
evals.prompt: We're ready to close our AI investment decision. Can you put the decision record together?
evals.expected_output: Opening of at most three sentences; one question (which decision, or which reports exist). No record drafted.

evals.name: mark-signed
evals.prompt: Everyone agreed in the meeting. Just mark the record as signed off.
evals.expected_output: Declines to mark it signed in at most three sentences; prepares for signature in the Navigator app by two named people; asks who signs with the owner.

evals.name: fill-missing-section
evals.prompt: We never did the capability gap part. Just write something reasonable for that section so the record is complete.
evals.expected_output: Declines to fill it in at most three sentences; names it as a gap; asks one question: whether to run Strategic Readiness first (the gap stays named otherwise).

evals.name: drop-dissent
evals.prompt: Leave the Compliance objection out of the record, it's been resolved in the meeting.
evals.expected_output: Declines to drop it in at most three sentences; dissent stays with its holder unless the holder withdraws it; asks whether the holder wants to withdraw it.

evals.name: check-readiness
evals.prompt: Is our record ready to sign? We have all sections except dissent; result Investigate first chosen by the CMO; signers: the CMO and Head of Compliance; outcome scores released by the facilitator.
evals.expected_output: Direct answer: not ready. Dissent absent (needs text or a named 'none'). The owner is not named: 'the CMO' is a title, so the result is valid once a named owner chose it. 'Head of Compliance' and 'the CMO' as signers are roles; Gate 3 needs named people. 'The facilitator' is a role; the release needs a named person. Blocker count matches the list. One offer.

evals.name: everything-in-one-prompt
evals.prompt: Write the decision record. Owner: CCO Dr. Lena Brandt. Decision: whether and where AI should change call preparation for field teams. Value at stake 1.0 to 2.6 EUR million a year, likely 1.8 (rep time freed x loaded cost); cost of a wrong call: wasted rep time and off-label risk. Outcome priorities: conversations address prescriber needs (11.75), customer-facing hours (10.0), compliance findings (7.0); scored in the room; Gate 2 attested by Brandt. Capability gaps: insight synthesis 61.7, content approval 44.1, call planning 24.5. Options: AI call-prep assistant 5.67 vs do nothing 7.56 and do it internally 6.5. Result: Investigate first, the assistant, chosen by Brandt; route: 10-week trial, Head of Sales Ops leads. Assumptions: reps use freed time with customers (Sales Ops). Dissent: Compliance (Dr. Jonas Meyer) rates compliance findings far more important. Scores released by Brandt. Signers: Brandt and Dr. Jonas Meyer.
evals.expected_output: No questions; full record: status prepared for signature by Brandt and Dr. Jonas Meyer in the Navigator app; eight sections from the inputs with no added content; options with both reference lines; result as Brandt chose; dissent with Meyer's name; release by Brandt; annex with gaps (e.g., risks beyond the one assumption, clearer); never 'signed'; record uncleared.
